note: The 5-tier market ladder. Deliberately independent of body style and size — a Camry, a Lexus ES and a Bentley Flying Spur can all be full-size saloons in very different tiers. `rank` exists so the ladder can be sorted without hardcoding the order in a template.

terms.label: Economy
terms.description: Sold primarily on purchase price and running cost.

terms.label: Mainstream
terms.description: The volume middle of the market, the default tier for most nameplates.

terms.label: Premium
terms.description: Positioned above mainstream on brand, materials and equipment rather than size.

terms.label: Luxury
terms.description: Flagship-tier brands and models where cost is subordinate to the result.

terms.label: Ultra-luxury & exotic
terms.description: Very low volume, coachbuilt, hypercar or bespoke-tier vehicles.
